sections.title: US proposes tariffs on China and its own allies
sections.body: The US Trade Representative proposed tariffs of up to 20% on 14 economies on 25 November, including China, India, the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, after a probe into excess capacity. China's rate matches its truce level, with 40% signalled if talks fail. Beijing said it reserves the right to respond; Japan and the EU protested. Rates go to public comment, with action possible in January.

sections.title: US fires on a blockade runner as Kuwait protests to Iran
sections.body: US aircraft disabled the merchant ship Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman on 26 November after it left Bandar Abbas, the first blockade runner hit since 7 November; Iran's navy vowed to break the blockade. Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador over the drone attack that killed two Italian technicians, and Italy says the drone was Iranian-made. Iran denies launching it.

sections.title: Hundreds of drones fly at Moscow as Russia hits Nizhyn
sections.body: Moscow's mayor said 462 drones flew toward the capital region overnight into 28 November, suspending flights at two airports. Ukraine says it hit a Tula plant that makes Iskander missile fuel and the Novoshakhtinsk refinery, and Russia extended its jet fuel export ban to March 2027. A Russian strike on businesses in Nizhyn killed seven people on 27 November.

sections.title: Ukraine offers Russia a Black Sea ceasefire
sections.body: Foreign Minister Sybiha said on 27 November that Kyiv has sent Russia a proposal for a Black Sea ceasefire to protect grain exports and is awaiting a reply. Moscow wants oil shipments included and Ukraine to stop striking its oil sector; Kyiv says that belongs in a wider energy ceasefire. The prisoner exchange agreed in Abu Dhabi has not yet happened.

sections.title: Poland moves to a no-fly zone on its Ukraine border
sections.body: Poland will create a no-fly zone at least 10 km deep along its Ukraine border, with rules due by early January letting pilots engage targets without visual identification. It follows Russian cruise missiles on its soil on 20 November and a drone over Lublin on 23 November. Trump and Rutte jointly urged Russia not to widen the war.

sections.title: Taiwan votes under Chinese military pressure
sections.body: Taiwan held local elections for 22 cities and counties on 28 November, with the Taipei mayoral race described as close. Its defence ministry counted about 33 Chinese military aircraft sorties toward the island over 27-28 November, and Taipei accuses Beijing of interference, which China rejects. Results were due on the evening of 28 November.

key_developments: US aircraft disabled the blockade runner Pacific Archer, the first ship hit since 7 November.
Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador; Italy says the drone that killed two Italians was Iranian-made.
Moscow's mayor said 462 drones flew toward the capital; a Russian strike killed seven in Nizhyn.
Ukraine offered Russia a Black Sea ceasefire; Moscow wants oil shipments included.
The FT reports a drone swarm was repelled at RAF Lakenheath on 13 November, with Iran suspected.
Taiwan voted on 28 November as about 33 Chinese military aircraft sorties flew toward the island.
since_last_visit_brief: US aircraft fired on and disabled a ship running the Iran blockade, the first since 7 November, as Kuwait summoned Iran's envoy.
